Riff Spotify (portable)

Run Riff.exe. Nothing to install.

- All data (library, cache, settings, plugins) lives in the "data" folder next to Riff.exe.
  Delete the "portable" file to use the normal location (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Riff) instead.
- Spotify engine: the Spotify button in the top bar, or Settings > Search engine.
- The "Custom colors" plugin is installed and turned on at first start (Settings > Theme).
  Ctrl+Shift+R turns off all plugins if something breaks.

https://github.com/skibididobdob228/riff-spotify
